meta.about: A 177 s flagship-smartphone launch film (2026), cut by its maker into one long piece. Narrated by one off-screen voice over a cinematic score. Brand, product, chip and mission names are slots here; the phone is a generic flagship (product_phone).
meta.measured_by: bin/dissect (cuts, brightness, loudness), demucs stem separation (music / narration), whisper word times snapped to the narration stem's voice onsets.
meta.cut_rate: 38.9 cuts per minute; average 1.53 s, median 1.13 s; long holds only on the opener (8.51 s), the hero (5.96 s) and the end card.
meta.aspect: 16:9 1920x1080; phone photos/videos shown full screen are pillarboxed 4:3 or 3:4 inside black bars (shots 63, 66-69, 75, 89-91, 98, 100, 104)

acts.name: Cold open: back from the moon
acts.function: Hook. A photo of the Earth rising over the moon turns out to be on the screen of a phone floating in a spacecraft cabin ('Once you've been to the moon, where do you go next?'); dip to black on 'Back to work.'; the music hits as a white engineering lab lights up.

acts.name: The chip
acts.function: Teardown flat-lay, the chip on the flat-lay, blueprints and glowing die graphics, a cave user, chip generations ending on the new chip's etched name, a lab microscope.

acts.name: Heat and battery
acts.function: Thermal camera, vapor-chamber graphics, the open phone on a lab table, a photographer hiking a mountain valley, satellite status icons, a test lab.

acts.name: Toughness and finish
acts.function: Water and drop tests, colour frames picked from a stand, back glass pressed on, spray rig.

acts.name: Designing the camera
acts.function: Measuring loupe, lens macros, X-ray lens graphic, aperture blades drawn and manufactured, lens test rig.

acts.name: The camera in the field
acts.function: Cavers on ropes in light shafts, surfers, a photographer on a tripod at a rock pinnacle, time-lapse, video editing with focus changes, picture styles, night photography with pro controls, glow-worm cave; climax on the music hit at 146.35 (surfer in whitewater).

acts.name: Recap and reveal
acts.function: Exploded view of the phone under the three-claim recap (chip, battery, camera), the parts fly together into the hero, finish swaps on the beat, product name on black on the final chord, silence.

shots.action: The Earth-rise photo holds full frame; the caption fades in 1.45-1.80 s and out 4.15-4.50 s. From 5.4 s the camera pulls back: the photo is on the screen of a phone floating weightless in a dark spacecraft cabin. 6.6-8.0 s the phone tumbles slowly and turns its back to camera (silver finish, the plateau catching the window light); it keeps drifting to the cut.

sound.files: set/score.wav is the film's music with the narration removed (demucs stem; 48 kHz stereo, same timeline as the film). The narration lives in set/lines/ (one clip per kept line, from the narration stem) and set/voice_narrator.wav. Score + lines placed at their times rebuild the original mix.
sound.music_arc: 0.00-9.45 low pulsing synth pad on 16th notes, about -25 LUFS momentary; 9.45 hit on the black frame into the main 92.5 bpm pulse (beat 0.649 s), phrases every 2 beats (1.30 s) with a short gap before each (10.77, 12.06, 13.36...); steady build through the middle (-15 to -20); 145.25-146.35 break to near silence on a black frame, 146.35 hit into the climax (146.4-154.8, -13 to -15); 154.83-155.49 bass-only breath; 155.49 finale texture under the three-claim recap; 170.09 final chord, one frame-group after the cut to the title (170.00); decay to silence by 172.3; silence to the end.
sound.bar_grid: Use the music stem, not the mix, for beats: 92.5 bpm; the opener's phrase starts at 9.45, 10.77, 12.06, 13.36; the finale's downbeats at 155.49, 158.08, 160.68, 163.27, 165.87, 168.46. Score joins in cut30/cut15 sit on these phrase starts.
sound.speech: One male narrator, off screen, never on camera: low voice (median pitch ~97 Hz), calm, intimate, close-miked and dry, about 3.4 words per second, short pauses between clauses. Rhetoric is second person ('you start with the chip... you add...') ending in a three-part 'than ever' recap and a callback to the opener's question.
sound.effects: No separate sound design is audible above the music; any whooshes and hits live inside the music stem.
sound.mix: Narration sits ~6 dB above the music (integrated: music stem -18.4 LUFS, narration stem -19.1 LUFS over the whole film, narration only when speaking); music swells only in the gaps between lines. Final mix integrated -16 LUFS.

look.grade: Cool, desaturated teal-grey with crushed blacks and soft highlights; skin and warm landscapes kept muted; the product's wine colour is the only saturated hue in most frames.
look.brightness: 0-255 from bin/dissect: product macros, CG and the hero on black sit at 10-55 (s13 9-54, s53 16-31, s113 35-52, s115 24-39); night and cave 4-35 (s96 23-24, s98 47); the opener photo 39-49; flat-lay and white lab shots 130-200 (s06 156-176, s10 173, s24 109-127); day lifestyle 70-145 (s35 72, s74 99-100, s101 123-144); end card 0-1.
look.contrast: High: pure-black backgrounds with one hard key on product; whites in the lab and flat-lay are soft, shadowless and slightly grey (never clipped except light practicals).
look.light: Product: a single hard or soft key from above/side, edges glowing, no fill. Labs: cool linear practicals. Exteriors: natural sun, low and warm (valley) or hard midday (surf); night: blue hour and starlight only.
look.depth_of_field: Very shallow on macros (only the etch or lens ring sharp); deep on landscapes, flat-lays and labs.
look.grain: Fine film grain throughout, slight halation on bright edges.
look.lens: Macro and long lenses (85-100 mm feel) on product and landscapes; wide 24-28 mm at water level for surf; screen recordings are flat.
look.no: No haze or smoke except vapor inside the vapor-chamber graphics and natural sea spray; no lens-flare streaks beyond the lens-test shot; no Dutch angles.

text_style.typeface: A neutral neo-grotesque sans (set/font_sans.ttf, Inter, open licence); mixed case, normal tracking (0).
text_style.caption: Opener only (shot 1): three left-aligned lines at x 15% of W, block 44-53% of H; lines 1-2 SemiBold, line 3 Light; 34 px at 1080p (3.1% of H), line pitch 33 px; white. Fades in 1.45-1.80 s, holds, fades out 4.15-4.50 s (0.35 s linear fades). Words: '{MISSION_LINE}' / 'Shot on {PREVIOUS_PRODUCT_NAME}' / '{DATE}'. Drawn: set/ui_caption_mission.png.
text_style.end_card: Product name centred (50% x, 50% y), Medium, 46 px (4.3% of H), white on pure black, 12-18% of W wide; two legal lines centred at 91% and 93.5% of H, 15 px Regular, grey #696969, ~45% of W wide. Hard cut in on the picture cut, hard cut out to black after 2.37 s. Drawn: set/ui_end_card.jpg.
text_style.etches: The chip name is laser-etched on the chip lid ({CHIP_NAME}, default 'C2 PRO'): large geometric sans, light grey on graphite, 'PRO' smaller underneath (product_chip_sheet).
text_style.in_app: Camera-app screens use the same sans in white and signal yellow #FFD60A for active values (ui_camera_pro_*).
text_style.rule: No other supers, no claims on screen, no end-line tagline: the narration carries every claim.

product_phone.fixes: The hero {PRODUCT}: a generic flagship phone, no logo or text anywhere. 71.5 x 150 x 8.8 mm rounded rectangle, anodised aluminium unibody in dusky wine #6b3a45 (measured on screen: #593842 in moderate light, #301c1e in the dark hero), frosted glass back panel slightly lighter #7a4d57. A full-width raised camera plateau covers the top 29% of the back (1 mm step, rounded corners); three large lenses (each ~20% of the phone width, black glass, wine metal rings) in a triangle on its left half: two stacked along the left edge, one to their right between them; a round white flash top right, a small black sensor below it, a pinhole between. Front: edge-to-edge black screen with a pill cutout. Finishes (finishes sheet, left to right): wine #6b3a45, silver #c9cacf with white frosted glass, black #1c2024, mist blue #8ea3bd. The opener's floating phone is the silver finish.

product_parts.fixes: The teardown parts for the flat-lay (s06) and the exploded view (s113): graphite midframe with the plateau's three lens holes, frosted back glass, black display, L-shaped black logic board with the square chip, brushed stainless battery slab, three-lens camera module, copper charging coil, speaker, vibration motor, flex cables, screws. Flat-lay paper #c9cdc2. In the exploded view the frame is the product's wine colour.

product_chip.fixes: The processor: square graphite lid #2a2d2f with chamfered corners, etched '{CHIP_NAME}' (default 'C2 PRO') in large light-grey geometric letters with 'PRO' smaller below, tiny serial lines along the edges. product_chip_die is the glowing cyan (#3fd0ff) die floorplan for the CG shot s13: two large core blocks top left, eight tall blocks top right, a 16-block grid along the bottom, traces running out to a dark board.

char_surfer.fixes: Invented surfer (s74, s101): man ~30, lean swimmer's build, 1.80 m, dark brown skin, short cropped black hair with a low fade, light stubble, calm focus. Plain matte black long-sleeve back-zip wetsuit, no logos; cream-white 6 ft shortboard, three dark fins. Not a likeness of anyone.

char_hiker.fixes: Invented landscape photographer-hiker (s35, tiny in frame): East Asian man ~40, medium build, short thick dark hair with grey at the temples, light stubble. Dark charcoal hooded insulated jacket, olive fleece collar, dark grey trekking trousers, brown boots, black 30 l backpack, black carbon tripod over the right shoulder. Not a likeness of anyone.

loc_capsule.fixes: Spacecraft cabin for the opener (s01-s02): instrument panels with toggle switches and two small blue screens on the left, cream padded panels and cables on the right, a trapezoid window upper right with hard sunlight. Very dark: brightness ~40-49, black shadows.

loc_lab_window.fixes: s04: near-black viewing room, a wide steel-framed window (17-82% x, 16-82% y) into a white engineering lab hall: long central table, glass partitions, rows of linear ceiling lights converging at 50% x, 42% y.

loc_lab_corridor.fixes: s05: white lab corridor, interior window along the right wall, a grey door at the far end, a tall light strip on the left wall, a duct unit lower left. Cool white, brightness 60-140 as the lights come up.

loc_dark_office.fixes: Background for the exploded view (s113) and the hero (s115): a dark open-plan studio at night, desks and monitors out of focus, tall mullioned windows, brightness 20-40, a pale table edge glowing along the bottom 4% of the frame.

loc_valley.fixes: s35: high mountain valley, golden tussock, huge dark limestone outcrops, a gully to the centre, snow peaks behind, low warm sun from the left; brightness ~72.

loc_surf_break.fixes: s74, s101: blue-green surf break, steep green headland cliffs with sea caves, dark sand beach, clear sky, hard sun (upper right in s101).

loc_night_pinnacle.fixes: The night rock pinnacle (camera-app preview in s96 and the photo in s98): a 15 m skull-like weathered limestone tower on a dark grassy hill, snowy ridges on the horizon, blue-hour sky with a bright planet upper left.

ui_photo_earthrise.fixes: The opener's photo (s01, 0-5.4 s full frame, then on the phone screen): grey cratered lunar horizon arc peaking at 54% of H, Earth a blue-white dome centred at 51% x, ~20% of W wide, 7% of H tall above the horizon; black space above.

ui_caption_mission.fixes: Transparent 1920x1080 overlay with the opener caption (defaults 'Lunar Flyby Mission' / 'Shot on Lune Pro' / 'Spring 2026'); redraw with the slot values in set/font_sans.ttf at the same position and sizes.

ui_camera_pro.fixes: s96: the phone's pro camera app, full screen, landscape. Left settings column (f/4.0 yellow, histogram, WB 3.8 -> 5.5, 1/22 SHUTTER, 0.0 EV, night mode, AF, RAW 48), 4:3 live preview of loc_night_pinnacle at x 281-1458, y 99-980, zoom ladder 8/4/2/1x/.5, white shutter button, f button, and a rounded white-balance panel on the right (vertical 'WHITE BALANCE', value '3800K' -> 'DAYLIGHT', five preset rows + AWB with radio dots; yellow dot = selected). Generic copy, no app or brand name.

ui_photo_night_halo.fixes: s98: the night photo shot on the phone: the rock pinnacle under the Milky Way with a thin white ring of light hovering above its top; shown 4:3, pillarboxed (photo at x 12.5-87.5%). Use the _frame version as the full 1920x1080 picture.

ui_end_card.fixes: The end card: '{PRODUCT_NAME}' (default 'Lune 2 Pro') centred on black, two grey legal lines at the bottom. Redraw with the slot values.

A more efficient chip uses less battery.'), for timbre and pace.
